_: False findings of check_accessibility.py. Key: the QML file; value: a list of {rule, anchor, why}. A finding of `rule` is skipped when `anchor` is one of the element's own lines, without indentation (e.g. "id: dayCell", "text: qsTr(\"OK\")" or a handler line). `why` says why it is not a problem.

src/WebPelotonAuth.qml.why: a tap anywhere closes the 'account connected' message, for a finger only; the screen reader closes it with Back
